classifications.rationale: The President specifies that the existing Portugal quota allocation must later be transferred to the European Economic Community and increased by a fixed amount; the operative legal modification is subsequently made to the tariff schedules rather than performed by this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: The quota allocations previously made to Portugal shall be transferred to the European Economic Community.
